sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A perennial pitcher plant of wet savannas and highland heath in southeastern Venezuela. Its identity has been revised because the historical type material may mix several taxa; the circumscription varies among authors.

sections.title: Pitchers and flowers
sections.text: Its leaves form open pitchers that trap small animals; a separate flower stalk bears pale flowers. The sources consulted do not support one reliable size for the plant under the taxonomic concept used.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use is documented; this carnivorous plant is not a food plant.
